'''Cerik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and later the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] Cerik was appointed by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to oversee the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]]. Unfortunately, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] tried with all tactics to disturb and stop the project; in the end with the help of an Imperial-aligned individual, the Sith destroyed most of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] units stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], then a Sith army assaulted the [[Olaris]] Reclamation Base, the resettlement headquarters, and in the fighting the Imperial killed Cerik and destroyed the base, securing [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] for the Sith.<ref name="TOR" />
